what: A small accent-color label follows the cursor late with .8s power2.out, and on entering an attached element, a round clip unfolds from the bottom-left corner in .4s cubic-bezier(.58,.01,0,.99) (25% upward) and the text gathers from a backslash (.2 + character count × .035 s, .27~1s). On leaving, it folds back along the same path.

options.text: Label text, default aria-label or View
options.look: Dark surface: accent-color text on the opposite stage background
options.chars: Characters mixed in while gathering, default \\\

from.where: shared.js .tb-stalker (all [data-cursor-text] links · cards · logos) — original mouseStalker + c-cursor-stalker__card

note: One label is made per page and shared by all attached elements, and removed when the last element is detached. Not applied on touch devices
